## Architecture check

Applicable guides: [best-practices.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/best-practices.md), [api-dtos-and-validation.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/api-dtos-and-validation.md), [caching-and-performance.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/caching-and-performance.md), [security.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/security.md), [module-structure.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/module-structure.md), [testing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md), [commits-and-prs.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/commits-and-prs.md), [reviewing.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md), [remarks.md](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md)

1. **[No speculative abstractions, unused exports, or dead code introduced (YAGNI)](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/reviewing.md#L45)** — [src/modules/relay/datasources/schemas/rhinestone-error.schema.ts:24](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/e2b0a57aa57765f9c8525bcb0c2877a95f6ee543/src/modules/relay/datasources/schemas/rhinestone-error.schema.ts#L24) — `RhinestoneErrorResponse` is exported but nothing imports it; the only consumer, `rhinestone-api.service.ts`, imports `RhinestoneErrorResponseSchema` alone. **Fix:** delete lines 24-26 (`export type RhinestoneErrorResponse = z.infer<typeof RhinestoneErrorResponseSchema>;`).
2. **[Builders and faker only](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/testing.md#L68)** — [src/modules/relay/datasources/rhinestone-api.service.spec.ts:214](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/e2b0a57aa57765f9c8525bcb0c2877a95f6ee543/src/modules/relay/datasources/rhinestone-api.service.spec.ts#L214) — the response literal hard-codes `{ status: 400, statusText: 'Bad Request' }` (also at lines 247 and 268) in three tests whose assertions are about `context` omission, truncation and the error cap, not about the status — the shape of [R-004](https://github.com/safe-global/safe-client-gateway/blob/main/docs/agents/remarks.md#L90). **Fix:** in each of those three tests use the same faker inputs as the first new case and the pre-existing sibling test — `const status = faker.internet.httpStatusCode({ types: ['clientError'] }); const statusText = faker.lorem.words();`, pass `{ status, statusText } as Response`, and interpolate `status=${status} ${statusText}` into the expected log line.

**Verdict:** ❌ 2 finding(s)
